name: std::map
desc: A sorted key-value container from the C++ Standard Library. Available without any #include. In C++ Mode, std::map replaces IntDict, FloatDict, StringDict, and Java's HashMap. Keys are kept in sorted order.
syntax:
std::map<std::string, int> ages
std::map<int, float> scores
ages["alice"] = 30
int a = ages["alice"]

methods.name: operator[](K k)
methods.desc: Access or insert value for key

methods.name: at(K k)
methods.desc: Access value with bounds check, throws if missing

methods.name: find(K k)
methods.desc: Returns iterator to element, or end() if not found

methods.name: empty()
methods.desc: True if map has no entries

methods.desc: Iterators — each element is a std::pair<K,V>
